screening_reasoning: CNN-based detection and counting of banana plants in UAV orthomosaic images; bounding-box detection/counting in a plantation/plant domain, not pixel-level crop/weed segmentation.
A LiDAR point-cloud quality-control and crop-characterization framework that detects row/alley locations; a geomatics/LiDAR study without a deep-learning crop/weed segmentation method.
Berry counting via CNN semantic segmentation uses images from a modified grapeharvester camera in a vineyard; a viticulture berry/phenotyping task outside crop/weed segmentation.
Leaf-area-index estimation from multimodal UAV data uses regression models (PLSR, SVR, RF, DNN); a biophysical trait-estimation task, not pixel-level crop/weed segmentation.
A review of deep-learning fruit detection and classification; secondary literature in the fruit/orchard domain, outside crop/weed segmentation.
A review of spectroscopy and imaging for crop/weed discrimination using machine learning; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.

Fully convolutional network (FCN-4s) performs pixel-level weed mapping and prescription-map generation from high-resolution UAV rice-field imagery, reporting overall accuracy 0.9196 and mean IoU 0.8473, satisfying UAV crop/weed segmentation with pixel metrics.

A project overview of an aerial-ground robotics system combining UAV and UGV for weed monitoring/spraying; it describes algorithms but provides no quantitative segmentation benchmark results in the abstract.
A review of deep-learning techniques for crop/yield prediction; secondary literature, not a primary segmentation benchmark.
Semi-supervised semantic segmentation of natural images for viticulture uses a low-cost RGB-D camera in a commercial vineyard (ground-level acquisition), without UAV aerial flight context.
A review of deep learning in image-based plant phenotyping; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
Maize tassel detection in UAV imagery uses TD-CNN and Faster R-CNN object detectors; bounding-box detection rather than pixel-level crop/weed segmentation.
A comprehensive review of deep learning for plant disease and pest detection; secondary literature, not a primary benchmark.
A review of deep-learning computer vision for smart greenhouse agriculture; greenhouse (non-UAV) modality and secondary literature both fall outside scope.
A review of IoT technologies for smart-agriculture monitoring and control; secondary literature without a primary segmentation benchmark.
DeepVeg semantically segments canola field images (background, crop, weeds, damage) with mIoU >0.76, but the abstract does not establish UAV aerial imagery, leaving the UAV-modality criterion unmet.
PVY detection in seed potatoes uses a fully convolutional network on hyperspectral line-scan images acquired by a ground-level field imaging setup, not UAV aerial imagery.
A review of challenges in using deep learning for agricultural decision-making; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A review of drone-based plant disease monitoring and detection; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A review of UAV path-planning and obstacle-avoidance algorithms for remote sensing; secondary literature, not a segmentation study.
A tiny-YOLOv3 model detects Convolvulus sepium and sugar beet with bounding boxes, reporting mAP and inference time; bounding-box weed detection rather than pixel-level segmentation.
A comprehensive review of crop-row detection for agricultural navigation; secondary literature, not a primary segmentation benchmark.
DeepLab v3+ segments winter wheat plants/soil from nadir-view high-resolution RGB images, but the acquisition is outdoor nadir (not UAV) with no stated aerial flight context.
A review of precision weed control technologies based on deep learning and machine vision; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
U2-Net extracts olive tree crown number/area from UAV visible images; a tree-orchard canopy extraction task outside crop/weed pixel segmentation.
